content.title: James River Group: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: PEMBROKE, Bermuda (AP) — James River Group Holdings Ltd. (JRVR) on Monday reported earnings of $1 million in its third quarter. The Pembroke, Bermuda-based company said it had net loss of 2 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs and to account for discontinued operations, came to 32 cents per share.
